scope: Initial planning comparisons only; no network, paid analysis, Blender render or provider submission. Later local-preview acceptance runs need their own recorded inputs and visual evidence.

evals.prompt: Plan a 12-second vertical commercial for a reusable water bottle from this text brief only. I want a push-in, an orbit and a side slide before the hero shot. Show me the 3D directing plan first; do not generate the finished video or invent product claims.
evals.expected_output: A feasible timed shot plan with product framing, final-look intent and assumptions; describes isolated local preview assets and honest available tools. No claim that existing Vivo scripts accept this job or that a render was completed.

evals.prompt: Use the saved Vivo/Apple reference observations as inspiration for an 18-second Bluetooth speaker ad: playful two-person interaction, varied angles and a closing hero. Make an original directing plan, with clear separation between observed reference facts and new shots. No browsing or paid video analysis.
evals.expected_output: An original adaptation with an 18-second timeline, source-evidence limits and clearly authored additions. It does not invent watched footage, reconstruct exact camera tracks or assume a speaker has fingerprint/Face ID features.

evals.prompt: Plan a 15-second Taglish UGC ad with two adult creators, supplied character sheets and separate selected voices. Lock the wardrobe and keep the phone consistent across three scenes. I only want the preview plan and reference requirements now; no invented identities, speech generation or provider calls.
evals.expected_output: Separate cast IDs and proposed identity/wardrobe/voice bindings, timed story/camera beats, unresolved asset requirements and a compatible speech/lip-sync plan. It distinguishes a sheet from provider inputs and does not guarantee identity or reset a consumed paid ledger.
